purpose.zh: 同时练伸髋和屈膝控制，强化腘绳肌
purpose.en: Train hip extension and knee bend together to strengthen the hamstrings.

text.zh: 保持髋高，脚跟慢慢推出再拉回
text.en: Keep your hips high, slowly slide your heels out, then curl them back

text.zh: 仰卧抬髋，脚跟踩在滑盘上
text.en: Lie on your back, lift your hips and rest your heels on the sliders.

text.zh: 拉回时脚跟回到膝盖下方，臀部夹紧
text.en: Pull your heels back under your knees and squeeze your glutes.

commonErrors.zh: 髋往下掉，动作变成蹭地
commonErrors.en: Letting the hips drop so the move turns into a scoot.

cautions.zh: 腘绳肌易抽筋，先从脚跟推出的离心部分练起
cautions.en: The hamstrings may cramp, so start with the slow slide-out part first.
